verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no native docs or notes capability in Jira itself. Shared documentation is delivered by pairing Jira with Confluence, a separate product: Atlassian promotes adding Confluence to organize projects, and Rovo surfaces Confluence assets alongside Jira work. A community report that creating tickets from Confluence 'randomly breaks' suggests the integration can be unreliable. Missing for 10: native in-Jira doc/note creation, evidence of organizing docs within projects, hands-on corroboration that the Confluence integration works reliably.
